about.label: What is Metwork
about.title: An incubator, a platform, and a national coworking network — in one place.
about.body1: Metwork is built for the next decade of Algerian entrepreneurs. We run a hands-on startup incubator and accelerator out of Oran, and we operate the platform that ties the rest of the ecosystem together — coworking spaces, partner incubators, mentors, and investors from across the country.
about.body2: One account. One network. Apply to a program, book a desk in Algiers, schedule a consultation with a CFO in Constantine, or pitch a fund in Sétif — without switching tools or starting from scratch.
about.pillar1Desc: Structured residencies with capital, mentorship and demo-day access.
about.pillar2Desc: One place for founders, mentors, incubators and investors to find each other.
about.pillar3Desc: Drop into Metwork spaces nationwide on a single, founder-friendly membership.

investors.heroSubtitle: Algeria's startup ecosystem is growing at a record pace. High-potential founders. Underserved markets. Real upside. Metwork connects you directly.
investors.whyTitle: The opportunity most investors are missing
investors.whySubtitle: While attention focuses on West African and North-African coastal markets, Algeria's combination of scale, talent density, and digital gap creates a compelling risk-adjusted investment case.
investors.reason1Desc: Algeria is the largest country in Africa and the Arab world, with a domestic market of 47 million consumers and deep ties to European and African export markets.
investors.reason2Desc: 68% of Algeria's population is under 30. A fast-growing university system produces 300,000+ engineering and tech graduates each year, ready to build.
investors.reason3Desc: Government incentives, new startup laws, and rising angel activity have tripled the number of registered startups in three years — still early for serious upside.
investors.reason4Desc: The 2020 Startup Act offers tax exemptions, equity protection, and accelerated business creation for recognized startups and their investors.
investors.reason5Desc: FinTech, logistics, HealthTech, and AgriTech remain massively underserved. First-mover advantage is still available in categories that have matured elsewhere.
investors.reason6Desc: A national network of incubators and accelerators provides deal flow, co-investment partners, and on-the-ground due diligence support for international investors.
investors.howTitle: From discovery to deal in three steps
investors.step1Desc: Filter active startup profiles by industry, funding goal, and equity offered.
investors.step2Desc: Click "Contact founder" on any listing. Our team reviews and connects you directly.

about.heroSubtitle: Metwork was founded with one goal: to give every Algerian entrepreneur access to the tools, capital, and community they need to build something remarkable.
about.missionTitle: One platform for the entire ecosystem
about.missionP1: Algeria has no shortage of talent or ambition — what it lacked was a single, reliable place where founders could discover programs, book coworking spaces, connect with investors, and access mentorship.
about.missionP2: Metwork changes that. We bring together entrepreneurs, incubators, investors, and mentors under one roof, making it dramatically easier to find the right people and opportunities at every stage of the startup journey.
about.value1Desc: We exist to lower the barriers to entrepreneurship in Algeria. Every feature we build is measured against a simple question: does this help a founder succeed?
about.value2Desc: Metwork is only as strong as the people who use it. We invest in the ecosystem — events, programs, mentors — not just the software.
about.value3Desc: We understand the local landscape. Regulations, culture, language — Metwork is designed from the ground up for the Algerian market, not adapted from abroad.
about.legalBody: Metwork is a registered Algerian company. All operations comply with Algerian commercial law and the personal data protection framework established by Law 18-07.
